strain: Sprague-Dawley rats; 5-HT2A receptor KO mice (129S6/SvEv); CREB αδ KO mice (129SvEvTac:C57BL/6 F1)

age.evidence: Male Sprague-Dawley rats (2-3 months), serotonin2A receptor knockout (5-HT2A−/−) mice ... and wild-type (WT) littermate controls (4-5 months)

dosing.doses_raw: DOI, 8 mg/kg (rats and CREB αδ KO mice); DOI (2 mg/kg) in 5-HT2A−/− mice
dosing.evidence: Sprague-Dawley rats, CREB ad KO and litter-matched WT mice, received intraperitoneal injections of the 5-HT2A agonist, 2,5-dimethoxy-4-iodoamphetamine (DOI, 8 mg/kg) ... 5-HT2A−/− and litter-matched WT mice received intraperitoneal administration of DOI (2 mg/kg) or vehicle (0.9% saline)

group_housing.evidence: Animals were group housed and maintained on a 12 h light-dark cycle (lights on at 7 am) with access to food and water ad libitum.

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on a 12 h light-dark cycle (lights on at 7 am)

assays.assay_description: DOI-evoked head twitches videotaped in the home cage for 20 min, starting 20 min after i.p. DOI (8 mg/kg in rats and CREB αδ KO mice; 2 mg/kg in 5-HT2A−/− mice) or saline. Total twitches counted by a blinded experimenter. Run in rats, 5-HT2A−/− mice + WT, and CREB αδ KO mice + WT.

application_type.evidence: received intraperitoneal injections of the 5-HT2A agonist, 2,5-dimethoxy-4-iodoamphetamine (DOI...)

setup_habituation.evidence: No statement about habituation to the home cage prior to recording.

setup_restrain.evidence: This behavior was videotaped in the home cage

food_restriction.evidence: access to food and water ad libitum

water_restriction.evidence: access to food and water ad libitum

time_to_assay.evidence: commencing 20 min following administration of the DOI or vehicle (saline) treatment

sample_size.evidence: n = 4 animals per treatment group (CREB αδ KO experiment); 5-HT2A KO HTR analysis used df=29 implying ~33 animals total.

outcomes.summary: Acute DOI robustly increased head-twitch responses in WT rodents. The DOI-evoked HTR was almost completely abolished in 5-HT2A−/− mice, confirming 5-HT2A receptor dependence. In contrast, CREB αδ KO mice showed an HTR response to DOI indistinguishable from WT.
outcomes.statistics: 5-HT2A KO HTR: DOI × genotype interaction F(1,29)=113.4, p<0.0001; main effect DOI F(1,29)=189.1, p<0.0001; main effect genotype F(1,29)=107.6, p<0.0001. CREB αδ KO HTR: no significant interaction; main effect DOI F(1,12)=58.64, p<0.0001.
outcomes.evidence: significant decline in a stereotypical head twitch response (HTR) behavior evoked by the 5-HT2A receptor agonist DOI ... the number of HTR responses evoked by DOI were unaltered in CREB ad KO mice

B1_num_measures.evidence: The total number of head twitches in this time window were counted

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only total count over 20 min reported

B4_ethological.evidence: Head-twitch response is a stereotyped pharmacological response, not natural ethological behaviour (per rubric)

B5_social.evidence: Animal recorded alone in home cage

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR does not require learning or memory

B7_automated_classification.evidence: counted by an experimenter blind to the experimental treatment groups

E2_shelter.evidence: No enclosed refuge reported within the home cage during recording

E3_bedding.evidence: Bedding not explicitly described for the recording session

E6_spatial.evidence: Home cage treated as a single space for HTR observation

E7_social_context.evidence: Individual animal videotaped for HTR counts

E8_food_water.evidence: access to food and water ad libitum (home cage)

D2_session_duration.evidence: videotaped ... for a total duration of 20 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Behaviour recorded on a single day post-injection

D5_followup.evidence: Recording occurred 20 min post-injection; no ≥24 h follow-up

judge_notes: Merged candidate 'Head Twitch Response (rats)' and 'Head Twitch Response (mice)' into a single HTR assay — same paradigm (20-min home-cage video, manual counts) differing only by species/genotype/dose, which per the rubric does not create separate assays except for species. Kept as one assay with species='mixed' at the study level; species is captured at study level and assay_description notes the cohorts.
Set sex='male' based on explicit 'Male Sprague-Dawley rats'; mice sex not stated but rats explicitly male, so study-level sex labelled male with medium confidence.
B4 scored 0: per rubric, head-twitch response is explicitly NOT an ethological behaviour.
E2 scored 0: home cage during a brief HTR observation does not provide a discrete enclosed refuge per rubric definition.
Dosing entry consolidated both 2 and 8 mg/kg doses under one DOI compound entry.
